bounded_shape_checks.method: DuckDB grouping on local one-hour sample, grouping by hex(market), timestamp
bounded_shape_checks.implication: PMXT price_change rows are flattened; source message boundaries must not be inferred from source timestamp alone. One-row NT delta emission is acceptable only as an explicit pinned live-client parity policy.
A safe PMXT-to-NT contract must include timestamp_received in the boundary/ts_init policy; grouping by market, source timestamp, and asset_id alone crosses received batches.

nt_reuse_surfaces.purpose: Resolve PMXT asset_id token ids to NT InstrumentAny::BinaryOption without custom instrument mapping.
Derive checked BinaryOption fields from source-backed Gamma market metadata.
Convert full-depth book snapshots into CLEAR plus ADD OrderBookDeltas with snapshot flags.

Convert PMXT price_change rows into incremental OrderBookDeltas. Pinned NT parser supports grouped PolymarketQuotes, but pinned NT live data-client emission wraps each individual change into a single-change PolymarketQuotes payload.
Convert last_trade_price rows into TradeTick using NT's deterministic Polymarket TradeId policy.
Handle tick_size_change rows by producing a rebuilt BinaryOption instrument with updated price precision and price increment.

draft_mapping_contract.mapping: Decode market BLOB as the source condition id string, use asset_id as token-id lookup key, decode bids/asks JSON arrays into price/size levels, convert PMXT timestamp to NT source event time, use timestamp_received as ts_init/coverage evidence, call NT snapshot parsing or implement an equivalent wrapper that preserves NT CLEAR/ADD/F_SNAPSHOT/F_LAST semantics, then write flattened OrderBookDelta rows to ParquetDataCatalog.

Use timestamp_received as part of the PMXT source message boundary and as ts_init/coverage provenance. Do not merge rows by market/source timestamp/asset_id without timestamp_received. Preferred mapping for pinned NT live-client parity is one PMXT price_change row to one single-change PolymarketQuotes parse call, preserving source order within message-like groups; grouped parser output is allowed only if tests prove desired F_LAST and book-state semantics.

Use asset_id token lookup for instrument id, price/size/side/timestamp for TradeTick fields, and either NT's deterministic Polymarket TradeId derivation or an explicitly approved transaction_hash-based policy; transaction_hash cannot silently disappear from provenance if it is not used as TradeId.

Apply NT rebuild_instrument_with_tick_size semantics before subsequent affected book/trade rows; prove whether the catalog should persist multiple instrument snapshots, an instrument event, or a single resolved instrument plus claim limit.

resolved_parser_field_findings.mapping_policy: For PMXT price_change rows, the converter may populate the NT PolymarketQuote hash field with an empty string for parse_book_deltas and parse_quote_from_price_change reuse, because pinned NT does not read this field in those parse paths and its own tests use String::new().

trade_id_policy_status.mapping_constraint: PMXT last_trade_price exposes transaction_hash, so transaction_hash must remain in TradeTick identity/provenance. Pinned NT's HTTP data API path provides a hash+asset+sequence policy, but the PMXT sample has exact duplicate trade observations with different timestamp_received values; the implementation must decide and test dedupe versus sequence before catalog acceptance.

price_change_grouping_status.mapping_constraint: timestamp_received is part of the price_change boundary and must not be dropped; one-row-to-one-OrderBookDeltas is the preferred pinned NT live-client parity policy, but implementation and catalog read-back remain pending.

tick_size_change_status.mapping_constraint: Pinned NT live handling rebuilds BinaryOption instruments and starts a book epoch on tick_size_change, but BacktestNode dynamic InstrumentAny replay is unproven. A first proof may exclude tick-changing assets only with explicit claim limits; full L2 acceptance must prove tick-size epochs.

unresolved_before_implementation: The isolated BTE crate must have an approved dependency or integration boundary for nautilus-polymarket before parser/provider reuse is machine-checked.
PMXT price_change grouping policy must be implemented and verified against pinned NT live-client parity, including timestamp_received boundary handling.
PMXT last_trade_price TradeId/provenance policy must choose and test transaction_hash+asset sequencing versus exact duplicate trade-observation dedupe before catalog acceptance.
tick_size_change dynamic instrument-epoch representation must be proven with NT catalog read-back and BacktestNode consumption, or explicitly excluded with claim limits for a bounded first proof.
The resulting ParquetDataCatalog proof must write/read InstrumentAny::BinaryOption, OrderBookDelta, and TradeTick under artifact_root staging; local prototype directories are insufficient.
The coverage ledger must use timestamp_received as the archive-hour coverage axis because source timestamp can be older than the archive object hour.
